player_prompt.intro:
Ko oonaa Player {player_id} e Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Simboolu maa ko '{symbol}', e numbeeru lesdi maa ko {parity} (e.g., X1, X3 or O2, O4).

Maksa: Kuutoro e jonta lesdi marks (solidified from superpositions) tati.

Kuutoro Foofoo:
- E kala saa, waɗa spooky mark e squares ɗiɗi ɗuuɗɗi e format '[a,b]'.
- Marks ɗin ɗuuɗɗi, e labeled like 'X1 / X1' or 'O4 / O4'.
- A jaɓa waɗa spooky marks e square ɗin ɗuuɗɗi collapsed (solidified).

Kuuɓal Rule:
- So tawon maa ɓalɗa cycle e entanglement graph, ɗum collapsed automatically.
- Kala spooky mark e cycle ɗin ɓalɗa classical mark e position ɗin ɗiɗi.
- Kala dependent spooky marks ɗin ɓalɗa collapsed.

Victory:
- Kuutoro ɓalɗa so player ɓalɗa classical marks tati e jonta.
- So ɓe players ɓalɗa line e saa collapse, ɗon ɓalɗa max move number ɓuri.

Misal move: '[0,4]' waɗa spooky mark e cells 0 e 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Limooreji je wala kuje mala ɗi ɗon mari ko hauti.

game_action.placed: Dan wasa {player_id} ya saka alamarta a cikin superposition tsakanin sel {pos_a} da {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Superposition mai kula da hukunci. Sel ({r}, {c}) yanzu {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition don sel na ƙarshe an warware shi. Sel ({r}, {c}) yanzu {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition an warware shi. Sel ({r}, {c}) yanzu {symbol}.

outcome.win: Jaawal {player_id} heɓan jaholji je ɗon ɓadake!
